hero.title: Your tools. Your models. One gateway.
hero.description: Point OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Codex CLI, or Claude Code at GPROXY. It handles translation, credential pooling, failover, quotas, and billing without changing how your clients work.
hero.passthrough: No translation needed · request passes through unchanged

funnel.title: Every request takes the same path.
funnel.description: Whether it comes from an SDK or a vendor CLI, every request goes through the same routing, failover, quota, settlement, and telemetry pipeline. No hidden shortcuts. No missed billing.
funnel.caption: A response cannot leave GPROXY until settlement is complete.

pairwise.title: Protocol details stay intact.
pairwise.body: GPROXY translates directly between real provider formats instead of squeezing every request through a lossy common schema.

unknown.title: New provider fields do not disappear.
unknown.body: Fields GPROXY does not recognize yet are preserved, so provider updates can still reach your client.

cli.title: Codex CLI and Claude Code just work.
cli.body: Use their normal login and request flows while GPROXY supplies pooled credentials and keeps every request metered.

providers.title: Multiple providers. One base URL.
providers.body: Pool credentials, fail over between routes, and enforce spending limits without reconfiguring every client.

runtime.title: Deploy it where you need it.
runtime.body: Run GPROXY as a native server or put the same core behind an edge worker.

connect.title: Bring the client you already use.
connect.description: Copy an example for your SDK or CLI. Sign in to see the models available to your account and create an API key.
connect.note: Your models and API keys are waiting in the user portal.
